title: ruellia hirsutoglandulosa
intro: Ruellia hirsutoglandulosa, commonly known as hairy glandular Ruellia, is a species of flowering plant in the family Acanthaceae. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in Mexico, for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The plant has been reported to possess therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Ruellia hirsutoglandulosa include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
